Name: Natural Dark Wood Interface
Author: enteis
Description:
Thank you all so much for the love on this interface! I'm currently working on the 2.0 version that will be much cleaner and that will have any of the bugs reported. I also wanted to add what's to come, and here's an overview of some of the things that will be included in v2.0:

[list]
[*]Three versions: dark, medium, light natural wood
[*]Better UI font: smaller, more compact and accented
[*]New, better and minimalistic buttons and font options
[*]Bugs reported in posts and bugs will be fixed, of course.
[*]Optional better and darker dig spots, alternatively non vanilla.
[*]Optional better soil and watered soil.
[*]Other minimal tweaks.
[*]Future compatibility with mobile.
[/list]
Since this is quite the project, it's going to take a while. I'll work as hard as I possibly can to make it something that is compatible with other mods. Hopefully you will all like the future better updated version!
[b]NATURAL DARK WOOD INTERFACE[/b]

[list]
[*]Transforms the bright orange/yellow interface into a darker, more natural interface
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 and Content Patcher 2.0.0
[*]SDV 1.6 Compatible
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*]This is still a work in progress, some smaller details might need fixing in the future.
[*]Only compatible with English as of now, but I'm planning on adding more languages in the future
[*]I am also working on a brighter natural wood interface.
[/list]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20044]*using animal replacements by elle[/url]

Manifest.Description: A natural, darker interface for Stardew Valley, compatible with 1.6.
